annotations.title: Skip merchants for now, or put them back

description: Set merchants aside in the By merchant queue — **a list in one call** — or put them back with `skip: false`. "I do not know what this is" is a real answer to a cryptic bank transfer; a skip writes nothing to any transaction. Names are the normalized ones `uncategorized_merchants` prints. **Dry-runs by default**; commit with `commit: true`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews and writes nothing; true makes the change.

merchants.description: Normalized merchant names, exactly as `uncategorized_merchants` printed them.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

skip.description: Default true: set them aside. False puts them back in the queue.
